premises: Grain boundary decohesion can occur in HEAs without significant segregation or phase separation
The CoCrFeMnNi HEA has a relatively high grain boundary energy (~0.87 J/m²)
High grain boundary energy implies a propensity for localized cohesive failure at boundaries
